productName: Heart Cutout Rib Knit Long Dress for Siroino

blockers: Replace nearest-body lower-skirt weighting with a deformation design that preserves a convincing long-dress silhouette in crouch and sit.

Rerender five views and six required poses, then directly review the new evidence before COMPLETE.

referenceAssumptions: Back-panel construction is not visible in the supplied reference and is not claimed as a literal reconstruction.

visibleDefects: Heart opening erased most of the upper yoke, leaving the collar visually detached.
